description: This file defines the Perl module Git::SVN::Fetcher, which implements a subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor to handle Subversion delta callbacks for git-svn integration. It manages file and directory changes, properties, and placeholders during fetch operations.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Fetcher
classes.description: A Perl module implementing a delta consumer for git-svn, handling Subversion delta callbacks to update git's index and manage directory/file properties during fetch operations.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Fetcher object, setting up configuration, placeholders, and internal state.

methods.name: _mark_empty_symlinks
methods.description: Identifies empty symlinks in the repository for special handling.

methods.name: in_dot_git
methods.description: Checks if a given path is inside a .git directory.

methods.name: is_path_ignored
methods.description: Determines if a path should be ignored based on ignore/include regexes and .git directory.

methods.name: set_path_strip
methods.description: Sets a prefix to strip from paths.

methods.name: open_root
methods.description: Opens the root directory for delta processing.

methods.name: open_directory
methods.description: Opens a directory at a given path.

methods.name: git_path
methods.description: Converts a repository path to a git internal path, applying encoding and path stripping.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Handles deletion of a file or directory at a given path.

methods.name: open_file
methods.description: Opens a file for delta processing, retrieving its mode and blob ID.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds a new file entry.

methods.name: add_directory
methods.description: Adds a new directory, handling placeholders and empty directory state.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Changes directory properties.

methods.name: absent_directory
methods.description: Records a directory that cannot be conveyed.

methods.name: absent_file
methods.description: Records a file that cannot be conveyed.

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Changes file properties such as executable flag and svn:special.

methods.name: apply_textdelta
methods.description: Applies a text delta to a file, managing temporary files and checksum verification.

methods.name: close_file
methods.description: Closes a file after delta application, computing its hash and updating the index.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Aborts the current edit, cleaning up state.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Finalizes the delta processing, handling empty directories and placeholders.

methods.name: find_empty_directories
methods.description: Finds directories that are empty after deletions.

methods.name: add_placeholder_file
methods.description: Creates a placeholder file in an empty directory.

methods.name: stash_placeholder_list
methods.description: Stores the list of placeholder files in configuration.
